Swimming World August 1976: a Microsel Timekeeper, six-function LED watch with 1/100 s split timer, through another
dealer. June 1977: Seagull the exclusive distributor of the Racer, sports wrist chronograph, polyamide case and
band, one ounce, LED, 10-day trial. November 1977: LCD Racer, readable in sunlight, shows time constantly, times
to one hour. Last ads January 1978 and a coupon January 1979. Maker's location and history unknown.

This article is a stub. Microsel made the Racer, a digital wrist chronograph with a built-in
stopwatch, which [Seagull Enterprises](seagull.md) sold as exclusive distributor from 1977.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
